fields.name: ErrorCode
fields.about: The error code, or 0 if there was no error.

fields.name: ErrorMessage
fields.about: The error message, or null if there was no error.

fields.name: StateEpoch
fields.about: The state epoch of the share-partition.

fields.name: StartOffset
fields.about: The share-partition start offset, which can be -1 if it is not yet initialized.

fields.name: StateBatches
fields.about: The state batches for this share-partition.

fields.name: FirstOffset
fields.about: The first offset of this state batch.

fields.name: LastOffset
fields.about: The last offset of this state batch.
